brief: Course creator who separates reusable source material from class delivery and hesitates on mixed administrative items.

tendencies.statement: Usually favors Teaching over Study for draft lessons, when context permits.
Often favors Study over Teaching for received reading, when context permits.
Tends to favor Reference over Teaching for reusable diagrams, when context permits.
Usually favors Archive over Teaching for finished course, when context permits.
Usually favors Keep over Move for active draft, when context permits.
Often favors Archive over Keep for finished course, when context permits.
Tends to favor Review over Move for unclear owner, when context permits.

exceptions: A mixed teaching and study handout can belong in either area until its actual use is known.

brief: Independent researcher who keeps reading notes close to study work but files durable citations separately.

tendencies.statement: Usually favors Study over Reference for reading notes, when context permits.
Often favors Reference over Study for citation library, when context permits.
Tends to favor Work over Reference for client excerpt, when context permits.
Usually favors Archive over Study for retired notes, when context permits.
Usually favors Keep over Archive for live notes, when context permits.
Often favors Move over Keep for dated excerpt, when context permits.
Tends to favor Review over Archive for unclear citation, when context permits.

exceptions: A citation used in both client and personal study work may need review before placement.

brief: Project lead who favors active work folders and makes separate room for durable patterns after delivery.

tendencies.statement: Usually favors Work over Archive for active deliverable, when context permits.
Often favors Reference over Work for shared pattern, when context permits.

Usually favors Move over Keep for active handoff, when context permits.
Often favors Archive over Keep for finished milestone, when context permits.
Tends to favor Review over Move for unclear revision, when context permits.

exceptions: A client template might be reusable or contract-specific; this profile leaves that judgment open.

tendencies.statement: Usually favors Personal over Reference for household note, when context permits.
Often favors Finance over Personal for payment record, when context permits.
Tends to favor Media over Personal for shared photo, when context permits.
Usually favors Archive over Personal for expired form, when context permits.
Usually favors Keep over Archive for current form, when context permits.
Often favors Archive over Keep for closed statement, when context permits.
Tends to favor Review over Archive for unclear bill, when context permits.

Tends to favor Review over Archive for unclear assignment, when context permits.
